methods: Classification snapshot key: roadway_name, segmentid, from, to, date and published direction. Sum seven mutually named source classes within 24 hourly columns.
Normalize only class-label spelling: Auto/Autos, Commercial/Commercial Vehicle, Taxi/Taxis. Preserve source labels in CSV.
AM window is 07:00–09:00; PM is 16:00–19:00; day is 00:00–24:00. Class shares divide class vehicles by all seven classes in the same day/direction/window.
ATR input is already grouped by street/year/month/day/from/to/direction, with count(*) and sum(vol). Select exact named bridge records; exclude Brooklyn Bridge Exit Ramp.
Coverage counts presence of source records. A count of96 intervals does not verify distinct quarter-hours, completeness, sensor validity, or representative traffic.
Values under100 vehicles/day are flagged for review as a transparent screening rule, not automatically repaired or declared sensor failures.
No seasonal adjustment, occupancy conversion, passenger inference, causal before/after comparison, or cross-date volume averaging is performed.

Pulaski southbound2013-04-13/14 have96 interval records but totals69/9. Record-count completeness alone cannot establish a valid traffic day.

Class counts measure vehicles. Bus counts do not reveal riders; auto/taxi counts do not reveal occupancy.
